arbiter: Hand-derived half-open sets on invented solar-day marks; no astronomical accuracy claim
units: hours relative to baseUtc; date marks are hours relative to that date's fixed-offset midnight

cases.derivation: Saturday's last night hour is Mars and ends at Sunday's sunrise at 6. Sunday's Sun owns [6,7); Venus owns [7,8).
Monday before sunrise still belongs to Sunday's night. Sunday's hour 23 is Venus from Monday 4 to 5. Monday's first two day hours are Moon and Saturn.
Sunday's twelfth day hour is Saturn. Sunset at 18 begins Jupiter's first night hour; Mars owns [19,20).
No earlier complete day establishes [5,6). It is unknown, while Sunday's supplied hours classify the rest.
At UTC plus 5.5 hours Sunday's local sunrise 6 is UTC 0.5. The selected hour ends at UTC 1.5; weekday ownership follows the fixed-offset date.
At UTC minus 5 hours Sunday's local sunrise 6 is UTC 11. Its Sun hour owns [11,12).
Every ruler is selected, so the supplied sunrise-to-next-sunrise partition passes entirely. The ending sunrise is excluded.
